contract: zone_check_halo #11 / #62 / #63: ZoneService.updateZone runs waterTick (pcall) after the gates and applyZone. In a town zone or within Config.WaterRescue.Margin studs of a town rect, a live player whose root is in Terrain water (ReadVoxelChannels at the root, RootSlack) for Seconds in a row (a dry spell of DryReset restarts it; a new character restarts it) is moved to the nearest dry land: rings of downward rays (Include Terrain / Map.Ground / Decor Bridge_*, IgnoreWater false, RespectCanCollide, the players' collision group when registered), a walkable non-water hit DryAbove..MaxRise above the surface, slope <= MaxSlope, not AvoidMaterials (CrackedLava), allowed for the player (level, enemy town), with room for the body (GetPartBoundsInBox; R6 legs counted); the lowest climb in the first ring that has one wins; markTeleported, PivotTo facing inland, zero velocity, one Toast line (Config.Text.WaterRescue, Sound None). Nothing dry: the near town's spawn when the player may stand there, else the Crossroads spawn. cleanup forgets the state.
limitations: The engine's ReadVoxelChannels values, a swimmer's real root height and the collision-group queries are faked; 메인 반영 1 checks the canals, the outer sea, the spring basins and the bridges in Play.
